title: Mercy that teaches the return
subtitle: For the day that must be received before it can be repaired
description: These readings follow mercy from gift to return, showing how grace gives the heart a way back without making excuses for distance.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The Lord’s pleasure, giving, separation, and reunion all live inside mercy’s larger movement.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let mercy make return possible without pretending there was no wandering.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey frames mercy as the power that both receives and redirects the wandering heart.
evidence.turn: Return becomes possible because grace is prior to recovery.
evidence.practicalImplication: Admit the distance, receive mercy, and take the next obedient step.
